name: ModelRelationship
description: Represents a relationship, currently in the data model, between two tables.

properties.name: Application
properties.description: Returns an Application object that represents the Microsoft Excel application. Read-only.

properties.name: Creator
properties.description: Returns a 32-bit integer that indicates the application in which the specified object was created. Read-only Long.

properties.name: Parent
properties.description: Returns an Object that represents the parent object of the specified ModelRelationship object. Read-only.

properties.name: ForeignKeyTable
properties.description: Contains the ModelTable object representing the table on the many side of the one-to-many relationship. Read-only.

properties.name: ForeignKeyColumn
properties.description: Contains the ModelTableColumn object representing the foreign key column on the many side of the one-to-many relationship. Read-only.

properties.name: PrimaryKeyTable
properties.description: Contains the ModelTable object representing the table on the one side of the one-to-many relationship.

properties.name: PrimaryKeyColumn
properties.description: Contains the ModelTableColumn object representing the primary key column in the table on the one side of the one-to-many relationship.

properties.name: Active
properties.description: When True, the relationship is active. When False, this relationship is inactive. Read/write Boolean.
